name: intuitive-software-design
description: A measurable standard with user-task, product-model, decision-support, multi-role, and evaluation workflows for intuitive software.

interface.shortDescription: Design and evaluate software users can predict.
interface.longDescription: Applies the Intuitive Software Design Standard through task walkthroughs, product mental models, decision support, multi-role handoffs, and UI/Flow/Feel reviews. Includes focused findability, language, and experience-progression guidance, formal audits, smallest-complete-change improvements, and a behavioral evaluation kit.
defaultPrompt: Audit this workflow for intuition failures.
Review this interface using UI, Flow, and Feel.
Help design this feature to minimize friction.
